styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Five Great Avenues villas, Italian Style Town and the Haihe riverfront.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Street breakfasts, seafood and Tianjin's famous snacks.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Concessions architecture, old temples and museums.

stays.why: Quiet leafy streets of old villas, walkable to the Five Great Avenues and close to the metro.
Central riverside base; walk to the Italian quarter, the Haihe and the main shopping streets.
Best for early trains and the airport metro link; handy for a short stay.

food: Start the day like locals: jianbing (savoury crepe) and guobacai from street stalls, a few CNY.
Try Tianjin snacks: mahua fried dough twists and goubuli steamed buns; buy small portions first.
Seafood is the local pride; look for busy restaurants near the riverside and ask prices before ordering.
Cheap eats cluster around the Italian Style Town and the streets near the railway station.
Tea houses and old-style cafés are good for a rest; check opening hours on the day.
more_time: Add a half-day in Binhai for the seaside and the striking modern library; take metro Line 9.
Slow down in the Five Great Avenues: rent a bike or just wander the villa streets for a morning.
Take a river cruise on the Haihe at dusk for the lit-up bridges.

recommend.why: One night covers the old city, the riverside and the food; add a night for Binhai or a slower wander.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 2°C, lows around -7°C. Bundle up.
Still cold, highs near 6°C; short days but few crowds.
Warming up: highs near 15°C, lows around 2°C. Good walking weather.
Pleasant: highs near 21°C, lows around 9°C. A great month to visit.
Warm and mostly dry: highs near 27°C, about 5 rain days.
Hot: highs near 31°C; carry water and plan shade at midday.
Hottest and wettest: highs near 32°C, about 13 rain days. Pack an umbrella.
Hot and rainy: highs near 30°C, about 13 rain days.
Cooling down: highs near 27°C, about 5 rain days. Comfortable.
Crisp and clear: highs near 19°C, lows around 9°C. Excellent for sightseeing.
Chilly: highs near 10°C, lows around 2°C. Bring a warm layer.
Cold again: highs near 3°C, lows around -5°C. Few rain days.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold, dry winters and hot, rainy summers. Spring and autumn are the best times to walk the city.

items.title: Best time: April to May and September to October
items.text: Highs around 19–27°C with low rain. Ideal for the Five Great Avenues and the riverfront.

items.title: Winter is cold and dry
items.text: January highs near 2°C and lows around -7°C, with about 1 rain day. Wear a heavy coat.

items.title: Summer is hot and wet
items.text: July and August reach about 32°C with around 13 rain days each. Go out early or late.

items.title: Rain peaks in midsummer
items.text: July and August are the wettest months. Keep an umbrella and a backup indoor plan.

items.title: Spring can be breezy and dusty
items.text: March to May warms quickly; some days are windy. A light scarf helps.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for spring and autumn, a warm coat and gloves for winter, light breathable clothes and rain gear for summer.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; Didi or taxi for short hops and late nights.

modes.text: 10+ lines, fares ¥2–8, trains about 06:00–22:30. Line 2 links the railway station to Binhai Airport for ¥3.
Old but extensive network, about ¥1.5–2 a ride. Cheap; allow extra time.
Taxis: ¥8 flag for 3 km, then about ¥1.7/km. Avoid touts at stations. Didi works widely; have your destination in Chinese.
Not needed for a city visit; metro, taxi and Didi cover the sights.
Best in spring and autumn around the Five Great Avenues and the riverfront. Summer heat makes long walks hard.
Metro Line 9 plus the TEDA tram reach the Binhai seaside area.
Ferries run from Binhai to Dalian and Incheon. Check schedules on the day.
